O1: "request for additional documents." - Body text / clause content. OTHER.
O2: "d. Within 30 days from the date on which the written notification from the Ministry of Health is" - Body text. OTHER.

O10: "3. Amend some articles of the Government’s Decree No. 104/2016/ND-CP dated July 01, 2016" - This looks like a heading or a major clause title introducing amendments. OTHER: neither.

All others (O1-O9, O13-O15, O17-O20, O22-O25, O27-O28, O30-O32, O34-O35, O37-O38, O40-O42, O48) are OTHER (body text, quoted amendments, list items).
